import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { changesets } from "./changesets";
import { redactions } from "./redactions";

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "timestamp" is timestamp without time zone, declared with `col.custom()`: Rebase serves it as the driver returns it, and `rebase db generate` / `db push` refuse it until the planner can plan a custom type (`custom-sql-type`).
export const relations = defineTable("relations", {
    columns: {
        relationId: col.bigint().primaryKey(),
        changesetId: col.bigint().notNull(),
        timestamp: col.custom("timestamp without time zone").notNull(),
        version: col.bigint().primaryKey(),
        visible: col.boolean().notNull().default(true),
        redactionId: col.integer()
    },
    relations: {
        changeset: rel.belongsTo(() => changesets, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        redaction: rel.belongsTo(() => redactions, { onDelete: "no action" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
